ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity black pixels with localized high-contrast white/yellowish pixel clusters at the distal extremities and scattered high-intensity linear/point pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black pigmentation across both visible lobes. Discrete, high-intensity yellow-white clusters at the far-left and far-right distal regions. Sparse white point-clusters on the interior ventral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 115-degree V-shaped central depression with moderate vertical pixel depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary with high-frequency pixel amplitude variations (serrations). Macro-level indentations located on the left lobe trailing edge boundary at approximately 30% and 60% distance from the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following the trailing edge from the central notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel groups at distal tips. Sparse individual circular white spots on the interior right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible unaligned white linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe (primarily vertical orientation) and right lobe (single diagonal orientation).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant cluster of high-contrast textured protrusions at both distal lobe tips. Multiple linear pixel disruptions (scratches) on the left lobe surface. Irregular non-linear indentations on the left trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial distribution and density of vertical linear marks on the lower-left lobe segment.
